description: Search Clara Carros' current stock of used cars in Portugal. Filter by make, model, fuel, max price and min year. Returns matching cars with price, year, mileage and a link. IMPORTANT — pass make/model canonically in Latin, as the Portuguese market lists them: make = full brand name ('BMW', 'Mercedes-Benz' not 'Mercedes', 'Volkswagen' not 'VW'); model = the short series/model WITHOUT the engine or trim suffix — BMW: series number only ('320','330','116', not '330e'/'320d'/'3 Series'); Mercedes: class + number ('C 220','E 220','A 250', not 'C220d'/'C-Class'); other brands: plain model name ('Golf','Corolla','3008', not 'Golf 1.5 TSI'). Put the engine/fuel in the fuel field, not the model. If unsure of the exact spelling, call list_makes_models first.

fuel.description: Fuel: petrol, diesel, hybrid, phev, electric, lpg

make.description: Full brand name in Latin, as the market lists it — 'BMW', 'Mercedes-Benz' (not 'Mercedes'), 'Volkswagen' (not 'VW'), 'Peugeot', 'Seat'.

model.description: Short model/series WITHOUT engine or trim. BMW: series number only ('320','330','116', not '330e'/'320d'/'3 Series'). Mercedes: class + number ('C 220','E 220','A 250', not 'C220d'/'C-Class'). Others: plain model name ('Golf','Corolla','3008', not 'Golf 1.5 TSI').

name: search_inventory
